mission_intent: Detect production-stopping events, scrap risks, and injuries in real-time. Focus on trim+final assembly where people and robots share space. Prioritize safety over quality defects.
mission_goal: Phase 1: Monitor vehicle-pedestrian near-misses. Phase 2: Detect missing/incorrect parts, rework loops. Phase 3: Monitor blocked aisles, material shortages, line-side staging violations.
mission_rules: Alert only with clear visual evidence; output UNKNOWN if uncertain. Prioritize safety events.
